visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 3D digital animation of the Earth. A stylized white airplane icon with a blue trail flies from the northern hemisphere, near the Japanese archipelago, toward Taiwan. The background shows a realistic satellite-style texture of the ocean and landmasses under bright, flat animation lighting. No characters are present; the focus is on the object and its motion. (2) The camera zooms in on Taiwan, and a pinpoint marker appears. A sequence of rapid cuts begins, showing the plane departing from Taipei to various global destinations including Seattle, Hokkaido, Istanbul, Hong Kong, and Nairobi. Each phase shows the plane's blue flight path extending across the globe, accompanied by city names, country names, and increasing distance counters. The setting shifts rapidly between continents, showing diverse topographies like snowfields, deserts, and urban skylines. (3) The montage continues with the plane visiting South America, including Lima, Cusco, and Machu Picchu, then moving to Asunción, Santiago, and back to North America with Los Angeles. The visual rhythm is extremely fast, matching the music. Each transition is a jump cut focusing on the new destination on the rotating globe. (4) The final phase presents an overview of the entire globe with all blue flight paths radiating from Taipei simultaneously. A final total distance text overlay appears in the center of the frame. The lighting remains consistent as the camera zooms out to show the density of travel across the planet, concluding the visual journey.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an explosive J-Rock introduction. Fast, driving drum patterns and a high-gain electric guitar riff establish a high-arousal energy. There are no spoken vocals, but high-pitched male singing in Japanese begins immediately. (2) As the music continues, the tempo remains high and consistent, typical of an anime opening theme. The mix is dominated by the energetic vocal melody and rhythmic guitar power chords. Occasional synthesized whoosh sounds appear briefly, synchronized with visual transitions, though the music remains the primary layer. (3) Throughout the middle section, the intensity persists with no significant shifts in volume or texture. The drums maintain a heavy four-on-the-floor beat with frequent cymbal crashes. The male singer's tone is passionate and animated. (4) The audio concludes with a final percussive hit and a quick fade, coinciding with the last visual frame. The overall spectral brightness is high, providing a sharp and crisp listening experience.
